conventions.name: workspace-package-structure
conventions.description: Shared workspace packages keep the metadata and TypeScript configuration required by the root toolchain.

conventions.name: component-entry-contract
conventions.description: Lazy component entry modules expose a filename-derived entry and use the canonical component-module resolver.

conventions.name: ui-component-export-contract
conventions.description: Single-component UI modules expose a filename-derived component; chart and icons are component families, and sonner is a dependency-named Toaster adapter.

conventions.name: ui-icon-component-export-contract
conventions.description: The shared icon family exposes named React components so consumers remain tree-shakeable and Fast Refresh can track each export.

conventions.name: hook-module-export-contract
conventions.description: Single-hook modules expose the hook derived from their filename; the excluded web modules intentionally collect multiple related hooks.

conventions.name: tool-module-builder-contract
conventions.description: Existing runtime and declaration tool-collection modules each expose a filename-derived builder; aggregate automation and Convex catalog modules have different contracts.
